title: SaLKo Overview
description: Grafana's home page: is the website up, and is anything wrong. Provisioned from monitoring/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/salko-overview.json.

panels.title: Critical alerts
panels.description: Alert rules (monitoring/prometheus/alerts.yml) firing now with severity critical: the public site or its data is hurt. The table below lists them.

panels.title: Website
panels.description: https://savonlinnanlentokerho.fi/ loaded through Cloudflare by the blackbox exporter every 30 s, as a visitor would.

panels.title: App & database
panels.description: /api/health on the production site: the Next.js app answers and its database answers within 3 s.

panels.title: Database (prod)
panels.description: postgres-exporter can log in to salko-postgres-prod.

panels.title: Kehitys (dev)
panels.description: https://kehitys.savonlinnanlentokerho.fi/ and its /api/health. The dev deploy restarts it, so a short DOWN after a merge to dev is normal.

panels.title: Monitoring agent
panels.description: Grafana Alloy on salko0 pushes metrics and logs here. SILENT means nothing has arrived for 5 minutes: then the rest of this page is stale.

panels.title: Warnings
panels.description: Alert rules firing now with severity warning: look at them soon.

panels.title: Front page load
panels.description: How long the probe took to load the front page through Cloudflare, DNS and TLS included.

panels.title: Server errors (1 h)
panels.description: Requests to the production app that Traefik saw end in a 5xx in the last hour.

panels.title: App errors (1 h)
panels.description: Error and fatal records in the production app's log in the last hour (nextjs/docs/LOGGING.md). The list below shows them.

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: Root filesystem of salko0. Postgres and the deploys fail when it fills up; alerts at 85 % and 95 %.

panels.title: Certificate
panels.description: Days until the TLS certificate visitors see (Cloudflare's) expires.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every alert rule firing now. Rules: monitoring/prometheus/alerts.yml. Nothing is sent anywhere yet: this page is where they show.

panels.title: Errors and warnings: production app
panels.description: The production app's error, fatal and warning records, newest first. Expand a line for its fields (module, err.type, err.code, IDs).

targets.expr: {compose_service="nextjs", environment="prod"} | detected_level=~"error|fatal|critical|warn" | json | line_format `{{ if .msg }}[{{ .module }}] {{ .msg }}{{ if .err_type }} · {{ .err_type }}: {{ .err_message }}{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}` | drop __error__, __error_details__

panels.title: Requests per second by status
panels.description: What Traefik answered for the production app, by status class: 5xx are the app's failures, 4xx mostly missing pages and bots.

panels.title: Response time
panels.description: How long requests take: at the origin for 95 % of real requests, and end to end for the probe's front page load.

panels.title: Errors per container
panels.description: Log lines detected as error or fatal, per container. Loki finds the level from the app's JSON records and from words like ERROR in plain text, so other containers can show false positives.

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: All container log lines, by the level Loki detected. The Application Logs dashboard has the lines themselves.

panels.title: Disk used (/)
panels.description: The red line is the warning alert's 85 %.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Every container cAdvisor sees on salko0. A short 'Up for' or restarts mean it restarted: compare with the deploys.
